programme.title: Hot Roads - Najniebezpieczniejsze drogi świata 2
Hot Roads - The World's Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Twórcy serii przemierzają najbardziej niebezpieczne drogi świata. Podróżowanie nimi kryje śmiertelne zagrożenie. Nagrodą są niezapomniane wrażenia, zapierające dech w piersiach widoki i przeżycie ekscytującej przygody. Czeka ich przeprawa przez pustynię, śnieg i lód. Trafiają w środek dżungli, przedzierają się przez górskie szczyty i wzdłuż rzeki. Odwiedzają wszystkie kontynenty o różnych porach roku. Nie jest im straszny szlak przemytników w Senegalu, syberyjskie pustkowia i zatłoczona autostrada nad Adriatykiem. Towarzyszami są mieszkańcy, którzy znają zdradzieckie pułapki bezdroży. Niebezpieczeństwo czyha na każdym kilometrze. Wielu przypłaciło życiem taką eskapadę Kanadyjskie drogi lodowe istnieją zaledwie przez kilkadziesiąt dni w roku, kiedy lód jest dostatecznie gruby, aby wytrzymać ciężar pojazdu. Tych kilka zimowych miesięcy to jedyny czas, gdy mieszkańcy północnej części prowincji Manitoba mogą liczyć na dostawy towarów z innych regionów. Kamera towarzyszy Vladowi i Hugh, kierowcom ciężarówek, oraz Scottowi, rdzennemu mieszkańcowi Kanady. Wszystkich trzech czeka długa przeprawa do miasteczka o nazwie God's Lake. Przed nimi niebezpieczna podróż, podczas której przyjdzie im się zmierzyć z temperaturami spadającymi nawet poniżej 60 stopni Celsjusza. Ta droga w niczym nie przypomina zwykłej autostrady.

programme.title: Najniebezpieczniejsze miejsca na świecie
World's Most Extreme
programme.desc: Twórcy odwiedzają miejsca, gdzie czai się prawdziwe zagrożenie. Są wśród nich lotniska, drogi, tunele i mosty, które z powodu nietypowego położenia zasłużyły na miano najbardziej niebezpiecznych obiektów na świecie. Widzowie zobaczą unikalne zdjęcia i mrożące krew w żyłach relacje świadków tragicznych zdarzeń, do których dochodzi na szlakach komunikacyjnych. Przemierzając niektóre rosyjskie drogi, kierowcy nie zdają sobie sprawy, jak mogą być niebezpieczne. Jedną z autostrad każdego roku podmywa fala błota, jednak dopuszcza się ją do ruchu. Lądowisko dla samolotów na zboczu góry może wydawać się szaleństwem, a jednak istnieje... Tory kolejowe tuż przy miastach również stanowią zagrożenie.

programme.title: Projekt Fighter
programme.desc: W programie biorą udział kandydaci gwiazdę mieszanych sztuk walki. To zawodnicy o wyrazistych osobowościach, dużych ambicjach i nieprzeciętnych sportowych umiejętnościach. Muszą sprawnie poruszać się nie tylko w klatce, gdzie czekają ich widowiskowe walki, ale też w świecie show-biznesie i mediów społecznościowych. Program ma wyłonić prawdziwego lidera, współczesnego gladiatora gotowego toczyć potyczki na wielu polach. Liczą się nie tylko sprawność i siła, ale też charyzma i charakter. Zwycięzca otrzyma 100 tysięcy złotych i podpisze kontrakt z Martinem Lewandowskim, współwłaścicielem KSW i prezesem Stowarzyszenia MMA Polska.

programme.title: Dover 24/7
Dover 24/7: Britain's Busiest Port
programme.desc: Widzowie zajrzą za kulisy portu w Dover, gdzie pracownicy terminalu, kontroli portu, policji i przewoźnicy promowi działają pod nieustającą presją, a ich decyzje wpływają na miliony ludzi w kraju.

programme.title: Misja Afganistan
programme.desc: Pierwsza produkcja fabularna o polskiej misji w Afganistanie, która opowiada losy żołnierzy 2. plutonu pierwszej kompanii piechoty zmechanizowanej z Wędrzyna. Dowódcą jednostki jest młody porucznik, Paweł Konaszewicz (Paweł Małaszyński). Jego podwładni są przekonani, że swoje stanowisko otrzymał dzięki protekcji ojca - emerytowanego generała. Głównym antagonistą Konasza jest porucznik Żądło (Tomasz Schuchardt) - dowódca 1. plutonu. Konflikt między oficerami pogłębia się, gdy zaczynają rywalizować o kobietę - porucznik Justynę Winnicką (Ilona Ostrowska). Na misji służą również m.in.: Zbój (Eryk Lubos), Iwan (Mikołaj Krawczyk), Mamut (Dawid Zawadzki), Malbor (Piotr Rogucki), Biskup (Marcin Piętowski) i Młody (Sebastian Fabijański) Pod główną bramą bazy zjawia się 12-letni Asad na starym skuterze. Chłopiec prosi żołnierzy o pomoc. Okazuje się, że jego siostra Fatima została oskarżona o cudzołóstwo i ma zostać ukamienowana. Rodzeństwo pochodzi ze wsi, której mieszkańcy są zastraszeni przez oddział pod dowództwem lokalnego komendanta talibów, mułły Wazara. Ojciec Fatimy zgodził się z okrutnym wyrokiem talibów, by ochronić pozostałych członków rodziny. Matka jednak pragnie ocalić córkę. Pluton dowodzony przez Justynę razem z oddziałem afgańskich policjantów natychmiast jedzie do wsi. Winnicka zamierza przekonać zgromadzenie starszyzny - szurę, aby uniewinniło Fatimę.

Letnie Igrzyska Olimpijskie Paryż 2024: Siatkówka mężczyzn - mecz półfinałowy: Polska - USA
programme.desc: Polskim siatkarzom udało się przełamać klątwę olimpijskiego ćwierćfinału. Dzięki zwycięstwu nad Słowenią 3:1 znaleźli się w najlepszej czwórce turnieju. Przed nimi bój z Amerykanami, którzy w Paryżu nie doznali jeszcze porażki. W ostatnim meczu pokonali Brazylię w czterech setach. Duża w tym zasługa Matthew Andersona i Toreya DeFalco. Pierwszy zdobył 20, a drugi 16 punktów. Polacy mierzyli się z reprezentacją USA już dwukrotnie w tym sezonie. Najpierw w Lidze Narodów wygrali 3:0, a w ostatnim sprawdzianie przed wyjazdem na igrzyska pokonali ją w Gdańsku 3:2. Prawdopodobnie w półfinale igrzysk w zespole Nikoli Grbicia zabraknie Mateusza Bieńka, który doznał urazu w starciu ze Słowenią.

programme.desc: O simbologista Robert Langdon tem de tentar resolver um assassínio e prevenir um ataque terrorista contra o Vaticano.

programme.title: Aposta de Risco
programme.desc: Depois de sofrer uma lesão que lhe põe fim à carreira, uma estrela do futebol americano resolve juntar-se a um conhecido corretor de apostas desportivas, para com ele continuar a ganhar.

programme.title: Sangue por Sangue

programme.desc: Los Angeles, 1928. Christine Collins é uma mãe solteira cujo filho desaparece sem deixar rasto. Meses depois, a polícia comunica-lhe que encontrou a criança mas, assim que o vê, Christine sabe que não é o filho dela.

programme.title: Hook

programme.title: Acordado
programme.desc: Clay Beresford, é um jovem milionário que aparenta ter tudo - dinheiro, uma lindíssima mulher e uma carreira lucrativa - mas, o que mais precisa é de fazer o transplante de coração que poderá salvar-lhe a vida.

programme.title: O génio do mal

programme.title: Sănătate cu stil
programme.desc: Prezentatoarea emisiunii aduce în atenţia telespectatorilor o serie întreagă de afecţiuni, cu care se confruntă tot mai mulţi români, şi oferă cele mai bune soluţii şi remedii pentru acestea, cu ajutorul celor mai buni medici din România. Telespectatorii vor afla şi cum pot avea grija cel mai bine de sănătatea lor, cum se pot hrăni sănătos, ce beneficii aduce mişcarea în viaţa lor, cum pot trata cel mai bine afecţiuni de care le este teamă sau ruşine să vorbească, dar şi cum îşi pot asigura o stare de bine cu ajutorul leacurilor din natură, al plantelor care pot face adevărate miracole pentru sănătatea lor.

programme.title: Connect
programme.desc: Emisiunea Connect își propune să prezinte săptămânal cele mai noi și interesante gadgeturi, de la cele mai cunoscute telefoane, laptopuri, wearables, aplicații și jocuri, la cele mai inedite proiecte care țin capetele de afiș ale presei de tehnologie din toată lumea.

programme.title: Mama
Ma-ma
programme.desc: Lupul si banda sa rapesc iezii Caprei, pretinzandu-i o rascumparare substantiala.Ecranizare a povestirii "Capra cu trei iezi" de Ion Creanga. Singurul film romanesc realizat in trei versiuni (romana, rusa, engleza) si partial in franceza."Mama este intr-adevar un spectacol fastuos, de o vitalitate usor naucitoare, dar calculat cu bagare de seama din scenariu, din regie, din imagine cat si cum sa fie fastuos, cat si cum sa fie naucitor". - Eva Sarbu - 1977 (Cinema).

programme.title: Schimb de mame
programme.desc: Emisiunea "Schimb de mame" aduce în prim plan experienţele inedite trăite de soțiile-mame care au curajul să își schimbe viaţa pentru șapte zile. În fiecare săptămînă, două soții-mame vor face "schimb de vieți", vor avea o familie, prieteni și o slujbă complet noi, într-o localitate și o casa cu totul necunoscute. La final, protagoniștii se vor întâlni pentru a-și împărtăși experienţele trăite în răstimpul celor șapte zile și vor fi premiați.

programme.title: Toate pânzele sus!
programme.desc: Peripetiile velierului romanesc "Speranta" prin Constantinopole, Pireu, Marsilia, Port Said, Montevideo, Buenos Aires, Tara de Foc, etc. "In numele solidaritatii, al devotamentului si al prieteniei, expeditia ii va purta pe eroii nostri prin aventuri pline de neprevazut, de greutati, dar si de poezie". Serial TV in 12 episoade, ecranizare dupa romanul de aventuri "Toate panzele sus!" de Radu Tudoran: 1. "Speranta", 2. "Secretul epavei", 3. "Bazarul desertaciunilor si Omul negru", 4. "Cine… citeşte.

programme.title: Duelul
programme.desc: Comisarul Moldovan trebuie sa rezolve cazul unui jaf asupra bancii centrale, avandu-l ca ajutor pe Petrescu (George Mihaita), un partener incepator. Lucrand sub acoperire ca profesor de sport, comisarul reuseste sa ia legatura cu singurii martori ai jafului, trei copii ai strazii. Pornind de la informatiile primite de la Limba (Jean Constantin), reuseste sa ii descopere atat pe Maimuca (Colea Rautu), autorul jafului, cat si pe adevaratul lider al bandei, Rica Pasarin (Ion Ritiu). Ultimul film al seriei "Comisarului". Sergiu… citeşte.

programme.title: Cronica cârcotaşilor
programme.desc: Emisiunea Cronica cârcotaşilor prezintă o variantă unică a celor mai importante noutăţi din domeniul politic, social, cultural sau economic. Telespectatorii vor mai afla şi cum stau românii la capitolul cultură generală prin rubrica “Vocea Poporului”, iar “Top Ruşinică” face clasamentul binecunoscut al gafelor din televiziuni.

Un format dinamic, rapid şi captivant, 50:50 aduce în prim-plan doi concurenţi care se confruntă într-o competiţie unde fiecare întrebare contează, iar şansele de câştig sunt mereu egale: 50% – 50%. Tot jocul se învârte în jurul numărului 50.

programme.title: Vlad Țepeș
programme.desc: In prima sa domnie (1456 - 1462), Vlad Tepes isi consolideaza puterea pentru a apara independenta tarii aflate intr-o dubla subordonare: fata de Poarta si fata de regatele Ungariei. Nemultumiti de politica sa, boierii se rascoala. Vlad prinde de veste si recurge la o pedeapsa crunta: tragerea in teapa. Dupa primii trei ani de domnie rezultatele politicii lui Vlad Tepes dau roade, tara e curatata de talhari si tradatori, poporul il iubeste. Pedepsindu-i insa pe solii turci care venisera dupa tribute, Vlad starneste mania lui Mahomed,… citeşte.

programme.title: Pup-o, mă!
programme.desc: Tică (Alin Panc) şi Horică (Sandu Pop), sunt, în sfârşit, stăpânii stânei şi se cred o partidă pentru orice femeie. Însă soarta le pregăteşte noi surprize, asa că Tică şi Horică ajung…vedete la TV, într-un show ce se numeşte “Înfruntarea bacilor”. 8 tinere frumoase intră în competiţie pentru inima celor doi, pentru premiul de 50.000 de euro şi titulatura de Băciţa anului.

programme.title: De ce are vulpea coadă?
programme.desc: Un cuplu bucurestean pleaca in concediu impreuna cu baietelul lor de 6 ani, Gabi, la parintii sotului, intr-un sat de munte. Are loc si un incident cu o vulpe si un curcan. Filmul este o "intoarcere" - in acest caz a unei familii traind in mediu citadin, in satul copilariei. Privita prin ochii copilului, "intoarcerea" devine absolut cuceritoare, atingand strunele sufletului celui care a lasat in urma universul copilariei de mult, prea mult timp. Bunicul si… citeşte.

programme.title: Iubiri secrete
programme.desc: Un serial care prezinta o serie de situatii dramatice sau pline de umor si ai caror protagonisti sunt oameni obisnuiti. Alaturi de familia Maris veti vedea ca banii nu aduc fericirea si povestile de iubire sunt mai complicate decat par. Plecand de la o poveste reala, Eugen, Valeria, Mircea, Radu si Andrei traiesc o viata ca in filme. Familia Maris locuieste intr-o frumoasa vila din centrul Capitalei. Eugen, capul familei, are 65 de ani si a mostenit dupa revolutie mai multe… citeşte.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Rebellious American teenager Danny falls for innocent Australian girl Sandy during the summer holidays, but when he later finds out she is a new student at his school, he risks losing her love by trying to act cool in front of his friends. Romantic musical set in the 1950s, starring John Travolta, Olivia Newton-John, Stockard Channing, Jeff Conaway, Didi Conn and Sid Caesar.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: A shy English boy joins the senior class at Rydell High and immediately falls for the leader of the Pink Ladies. But she is only interested in tough guys, forcing him to adopt a dual identity as a mysterious biker. Musical sequel, starring Michelle Pfeiffer, Maxwell Caulfield, Lorna Luft, Eve Arden and Sid Caesar, with Didi Conn reprising her role as Frenchy from the original film.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious, hip-swinging student from the city moves to a small religious community, where he instantly clashes with an old-school fire-and-brimstone preacher - who has banned dancing and rock 'n' roll because he considers them immoral. Drama, starring Kevin Bacon, Lori Singer, John Lithgow, Chris Penn, Dianne Wiest and Sarah Jessica Parker.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A teenager from Boston moves to a small conservative town, and discovers the council and a preacher have enforced a ban on loud music and dancing. He openly defies the harsh rules, revitalising the local youth and winning the heart of the reverend's daughter. Remake of the 1984 drama, with Kenny Wormald, Julianne Hough and Dennis Quaid.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo
programme.desc: The hapless hound and his chums reunite after a bitter break-up to solve a baffling mystery in the ghost-themed tourist resort of Spooky Island, whose owner is convinced he has a genuine haunting on his hands. Live-action comedy adventure based on the cartoon series, starring Sarah Michelle Gellar, Matthew Lillard, Freddie Prinze Jr, Linda Cardellini and Rowan Atkinson.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo 2: Monsters Unleashed
programme.desc: The amateur detectives attend the grand opening of a museum in their honour, featuring the costumes from all the fake monsters they exposed. The exhibits are stolen by a masked villain, who sets about re-creating all the gang's worst enemies. Comedy adventure sequel, starring Sarah Michelle Gellar, Matthew Lillard, Freddie Prinze Jr and Linda Cardellini.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Trapped
programme.desc: This edition of The Cinema List is about being trapped. From the depths of the ocean in 47 Meters Down to the vastness of space in Gravity, getting out is easier said than done.

programme.title: Grease

Musical sequel, starring Michelle Pfeiffer, Maxwell Caulfield, Lorna Luft, Eve Arden and Sid Caesar, with Didi Conn reprising her role as Frenchy from the original film.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: A crook double-crosses his partners in crime, a betrayal that leaves their friend and mentor dead. One year later, they regroup and come up with a daring plan to exact revenge on the traitor and reclaim their ill-gotten gains. Crime thriller inspired by the 1969 movie, starring Mark Wahlberg, Charlize Theron, Edward Norton, Seth Green and Donald Sutherland.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: A crook assembles a motley gang to steal £4million in gold bullion from an Italian armoured car, which brings Turin to a standstill and enables the robbers to make a quick getaway in a fleet of Minis - but they end up falling foul of the Mafia along the way. Crime comedy, starring Michael Caine, Noel Coward, Benny Hill, Tony Beckley and John Le Mesurier.

programme.title: Police Academy
programme.desc: An American police college lowers its entrance requirements in the hope of attracting new recruits, and in response, assorted dubious candidates turn up for enrolment. A short-tempered instructor is determined to weed out the bad apples, but a riot provides the clueless cops with a chance to prove their worth. Comedy, starring Steve Guttenberg, Kim Cattrall, Bubba Smith and GW Bailey.

programme.title: Police Academy 2: Their First Assignment
programme.desc: America's most inept cops graduate and are let loose on the streets - under the command of an unscrupulous lieutenant whose promotion depends on their failure. Fortunately for him, their unique brand of policing actually leads to an increase in the crime rate. Comedy sequel, starring Steve Guttenberg, Bubba Smith, David Graf and Michael Winslow.

programme.title: Police Academy 3: Back in Training
programme.desc: Facing closure from cutbacks in public spending and competition from a more successful academy, the police training school calls on its bungling graduates to act as instructors and make good officers out of a bunch of new recruits even more incompetent than they are. Comedy sequel, starring Steve Guttenberg, Bubba Smith, Michael Winslow and Art Metrano.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop
programme.desc: Fast-talking Detroit cop Axel Foley heads for Los Angeles after an old friend is murdered before his eyes. His search for the killers leads him into conflict with a seemingly untouchable drug kingpin, but he also has to contend with the local force, who do not want him taking matters into his own hands. Comedy thriller, starring Eddie Murphy, Judge Reinhold, Ronny Cox, John Ashton and Steven Berkoff.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop II
programme.desc: Wisecracking Detroit detective Axel Foley returns to Los Angeles to investigate the shooting of an old friend, and uncovers a connection with a spate of violent robberies carried out by a criminal who leaves a mysterious calling card. Comedy thriller sequel, starring Eddie Murphy, Judge Reinhold, John Ashton, Ronny Cox and Brigitte Nielsen.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop III
programme.desc: Maverick cop Axel Foley returns to Los Angeles when an investigation into a colleague's murder leads him to a Hollywood theme park. He enlists the help of old ally Rosewood to prove the resort is a cover for a major counterfeiting ring connected to a terrorist conspiracy. Comedy adventure sequel, starring Eddie Murphy, Judge Reinhold, Theresa Randle and Bronson Pinchot.

programme.title: Ghostbusters
programme.desc: Three eccentric scientists put their hi-tech gadgetry and knowledge of the paranormal to money-making use by setting up in business as freelance ghost catchers. A musician calls them in to investigate when she sees strange creatures in her kitchen, only to end up possessed. As the spook-hunting team members deal with an attempt to shut their operation down, they discover an evil demonic entity is being summoned into existence and it falls to them to stop this creature from destroying the world. Supernatural comedy adventure, starring Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Harold Ramis, Sigourney Weaver, Ernie Hudson and Rick Moranis.

programme.title: Ghostbusters II
programme.desc: The eccentric spectre-hunters reunite to save New York from a massive river of slime generated by the citizens' negativity and nasty thoughts. Meanwhile, the spirit of a 16th-century tyrant tries to return to the land of the living by possessing the body of a toddler. Sequel to the supernatural comedy, starring Bill Murray, Sigourney Weaver, Dan Aykroyd, Harold Ramis, Rick Moranis and Ernie Hudson.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Afterlife
programme.desc: When a single mum and her two kids arrive in a small town, they begin to discover their connection to the original Ghostbusters and the secret legacy their grandfather Egon Spengler left behind. Supernatural comedy sequel, directed by Jason Reitman and starring Carrie Coon, Paul Rudd, Finn Wolfhard and Mckenna Grace, with cameo appearances by Bill Murray, Dan Aykroyd, Ernie Hudson, Annie Potts and Sigourney Weaver.

programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
programme.desc: An eccentric but brilliant former cop sets himself up to champion the underdog - as a private eye specialising in locating missing animals. The zany detective is called in to find a kidnapped dolphin - the mascot of an American football team - and uncovers a plot involving high-level police corruption. Comedy, starring Jim Carrey, Courteney Cox, Sean Young, Tone Loc and Noble Willingham.

programme.title: Lethal Weapon
programme.desc: An unstable Vietnam veteran cop teams up with a by-the-book Los Angeles police detective to investigate the apparent suicide of the daughter of a wealthy businessman, leading them to a violent and bloody confrontation with a ruthless drug cartel under the control of a retired US general. Action thriller, starring Mel Gibson, Danny Glover, Gary Busey, Mitchell Ryan and Tom Atkins.

programme.title: Lethal Weapon 2
programme.desc: Headstrong cop Martin Riggs and his cautious partner Roger Murtaugh stumble across a plot by a South African diplomat to launder drugs money by shipping gold coins into the US via his embassy. Protected by diplomatic immunity, the crook looks certain to evade the law - while his chief henchman has a connection to Riggs' traumatic past. Action thriller sequel, with Mel Gibson, Danny Glover, Joe Pesci, Joss Ackland, Derrick O'Connor and Patsy Kensit.

programme.title: Lethal Weapon 3
programme.desc: As Murtagh counts down his last few days on the force before retirement, he and Riggs go on the trail of a former LAPD officer who is using his insider knowledge to steal confiscated weaponry and ammunition, then selling it on to criminal gang bosses. The duo are assigned to work with internal affairs investigator Lorna Cole, while they also get help from old friend - and reformed small-time crook - Leo Getz. Action thriller sequel, starring Mel Gibson, Danny Glover, Joe Pesci and Rene Russo.

programme.title: Lethal Weapon 4
programme.desc: Mismatched LAPD detectives Riggs and Murtaugh stumble across a ship transporting Chinese immigrants into the US. As they try to get to the bottom of the organisation behind the smuggling, they find themselves up against a master criminal who is an expert in martial arts and heads a triad responsible for people-trafficking and forgery. Action adventure sequel, starring Mel Gibson, Danny Glover, Rene Russo, Joe Pesci, Jet Li and Chris Rock.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Detectives Mike Lowrey and Marcus Burnett search for a $100million heroin consignment brazenly stolen by a French drug kingpin from the police evidence room. However, after a mix-up over a phone call from a potential witness, each cop has to assume the other's identity - Lowrey becoming the henpecked family man and Burnett the playboy. Michael Bay's action thriller, starring Will Smith, Martin Lawrence, Tea Leoni, Tcheky Karyo and Theresa Randle.

programme.title: Bad Boys II
programme.desc: Two mismatched undercover cops set out to halt an underground gang war and bring down a drug lord attempting to flood the market with a deadly form of Ecstasy. However, a romantic interlude threatens to drive the investigation off course. Comedy thriller sequel, starring Will Smith, Martin Lawrence, Gabrielle Union, Jordi Molla and Peter Stormare.
